opening.text: I have a painful swelling on the right side of my neck, which began as a painful lump there. The fever came on after the lump in my neck, and this has been going on for 3 weeks. It has gone up to 40 °C. I've been feeling nauseous and tired. I've had a course of amoxicillin–clavulanate, metronidazole, and clindamycin.
